comment: The statement that an interaction is not the unit of conformance is reasonable for actor-role certification, but end-to-end interoperability also depends on the interaction between multiple tested systems. Component-level testing alone may not demonstrate successful exchange.

anchor.note: p.81 l.Lines 1063-1066 read as the printed page; section 3.7.2 agrees

public.text: The statement that an interaction is not the unit of conformance is reasonable for actor-role certification, but end-to-end interoperability also depends on the interaction between multiple tested systems. Component-level testing alone may not demonstrate successful exchange.
public.suggestedRevision: Add bilateral and multilateral interoperability testing, workflow testing, and end-to-end scenario testing in addition to actor-role conformance.
